app.title: SCI Toolbox
help.relative:
Record the relative position between two objects and apply it to others.
1. Select two objects (the first is the reference) and press Copy — their offset fills the X/Y fields;
2. Select the objects to move and press Paste to place them at the same relative position.
X/Y accept manual values; choose which corner/centre to reference.
help.distribute.alignment:
Align the selected objects with each other.
Select two or more objects and click an icon: objects align to the selection’s overall bounds by left/centre/right/top/bottom. Hover an icon for its specific effect.
help.distribute.distribution:
Distribute the selected objects with even spacing.
Needs three or more objects: distributes horizontally or vertically so neighbouring gaps are equal.
help.distribute.spacing:
Set the spacing between selected objects to a fixed value.
Horizontal/Vertical Even Spacing re-distributes objects using the value (mm) in the field.
help.distribute.paste:
Shift the selected objects by the spacing value in the field.
Copy measures the current spacing; left/right (or up/down) chooses which end anchors the layout.
help.arrange:
Lay images out in a grid.
Set columns and row/column gaps (mm), then press Arrange: optionally unify sizes; order supports grid/stacking/horizontal/vertical and can be reversed.
help.swap:
Swap the positions of two objects.
Select exactly two objects and click a button: they exchange places, aligned by the chosen reference point (nine positions); objects of different sizes align at that point.
help.size:
Unify object sizes.
1. Select one object and press Copy Size, or type width/height (mm) directly;
2. Select targets and press Paste Size.
Checking only width or height scales proportionally; checking both stretches to the exact size.
help.labels:
Batch-add lettered labels to images.
Select objects and press Add Labels: generates a / A / (a) templates in the chosen order; font, size, colour and offset are adjustable. Update re-numbers existing labels; the arrow undo button reverts the last numbering.
help.border:
Add a frame around images.
Select image(s) and press Add Border: colour, thickness and dashes are configurable; frames are auto-grouped by default.
help.pseudocolor:
Map greyscale images to colour (pseudocolour) by brightness.
Select a placed greyscale image, choose a palette and direction, then press Apply; keeping the original is optional.
help.merge:
Channel merge: combine same-sized greyscale images into one colour image.
Assign a channel to each image, then press Apply.
help.scale.fov: Fill in the field of view first: width/height and unit come from the microscope acquisition settings and convert the scalebar to its true length.
help.scale.barStyle: Scalebar style: orientation, length, thickness, colour, whether to show text; press apply to update.
help.scale.fontStyle: Scalebar text style: size, colour, bold.
help.palettes:
Scientific colour palettes.
Left-click a colour to fill the selected shapes; right-click to copy its value. Manage groups and edit custom palettes.
help.pdf.cleanup:
Clean up an imported PDF or any normal selection.
Select the PDF’s top-level group (or ordinary objects) and press Clean: removes white backgrounds and unused paths, sets text to Arial, releases masks, ungroups and embeds placed images; the report lists what was removed and the scope. Loose white/empty paths selected directly are cleaned as well. With “Remove white text” checked, text objects filled white (e.g. FFFFFF) are deleted too. “Remove white paths” is checked by default; uncheck it to keep white background paths during cleanup.
help.pdf.ratio:
Change an image’s aspect ratio.
Select non-text objects only, enter the target ratio, choose keep-height or keep-width, then press Change Ratio.
help.selection.filter: Filter the current selection: text / paths (lines) / shapes (closed paths, each one level into groups). Check "Invert filter" to select the objects that do not match the chosen type instead.
help.selection.textTools:
Split / merge text frames.
Split: break a text frame’s space-separated pieces into separate frames (kept at their original positions); Merge: combine several frames in reading order. Inverse operations.
help.selection.modifyText: Change the selected text frames (one level into groups) to the chosen font and size; stays in sync with the defaults in Settings.
help.selection.modifyLine: Change every path inside the selected objects (one level into groups, inside compound paths) to the chosen stroke width; stays in sync with the defaults in Settings.

The new frames are selected afterwards for further alignment.
texttools.mergeHint: Merge the selected text frames in reading order (top to bottom, left to right within a line) into one frame: pieces on the same line join with spaces, different lines become new lines; the style and position come from the leftmost frame of the first row and the rest are deleted. Inverse of Split Text.
pdf.cleanupDescription: Select the top-level group of an imported PDF, or any ordinary objects, to clean clear backgrounds and unused paths (with "Remove white paths" checked, unstroked white-filled paths at any nesting level count as background, including loose white paths selected directly), change editable text to Arial, release masks, ungroup items and embed placed objects; white paths exposed by released masks are cleaned again afterwards. Existing font sizes are preserved.
